budget.cached_input: subset of input, not added twice
budget.reasoning_output: subset of output, not added twice
budget.preparation_and_previous_trial_usage: Separate sunk work; incomplete/UNKNOWN, not zero and not deducted from a future savings claim.
budget.root_chat_and_final_publication_usage: Separate administrative overhead, measured if attributable, otherwise UNKNOWN; outside this participant envelope.
budget.money_reason: No verified tariff/invoice for these collaboration aliases. Token envelope is not a monetary or subscription-quota cap.
budget.enforcement: Coordinated admission and observed stop threshold, not a hard provider-side token ceiling.
budget.stop_rule: Before each phase/review admit only its reserved allocation; if any usage is missing/ambiguous, if the previous allocation is exceeded, or if 600000 conservatively accounted tokens are reached, interrupt active work where possible and start nothing else. Retain all costs including overrun.
budget.conservative_admission_accounting: When overlap is unknown, parent plus child deltas may be summed only as a conservative operational charge, explicitly not a measured consumption total. Missing counters block the next phase.
budget.reporting_accounting: Sum only proven disjoint complete scopes. Otherwise report per-session known values and UNKNOWN combined usage/cost.

workspace.verifier_policy: All frozen acceptance inputs are public in this diagnostic. No hidden-test or OS-isolation claim. Hash-check trusted verifier before/after and run it from coordinator-owned evidence directory.
workspace.os_cross_session_isolation: UNKNOWN; fresh contexts and separate workspaces are logical separation only.

acceptance.revocation: Retain earlier verdict and publish a later revocation bound to the selected patch digest.

capture.raw_logs: Explicit participant session IDs and their exact local trace paths only; no bulk session scan or provider bodies in public exports.
capture.start: Retain task/session/model/effort identity and initial usage snapshot or proven new-session cumulative origin.
capture.during: Observe cumulative counters after available provider turns; interruption is best effort, never an in-flight spend guarantee.
capture.end: After participant completion, retain terminal cumulative snapshot and event index/hash; never substitute last_token_usage for total task usage.
capture.model_identity: Requested tool arguments and observed host turn metadata are distinct; missing/mismatched model or effort stops the next phase. Provider identity stays UNKNOWN.
capture.complete_scope: Require session/task binding, monotonic counters, all phases and retries, missing-field handling and disjointness evidence before combining.
capture.cache_write_input_tokens: Absent value remains null, not zero; M2 combined usage may therefore stay unknown.
capture.privacy: Publish allowlisted counters, hashes and verdicts; retain prompts, raw traces and private paths locally.
capture.m2_reuse: Project each complete participant window through M2 report; use a patch digest for Python revision. Physical call IDs cannot be invented from session IDs.
capture.native_accounting_projection: Unavailable until physical-work identity evidence exists; no synthetic stand-in for real calls.
